snapshot.description: Bootstrap model establishing ecosystem and environment identities.

entities.name: MSYS2
entities.summary: Software distribution and development environment for Windows.

entities.name: msys-2.0.dll
entities.summary: MSYS2 POSIX compatibility runtime.

entities.name: GNU Bash
entities.summary: The GNU Bourne-Again shell, packaged in the MSYS environment as the default interactive and login command interpreter.

entities.name: GNU Coreutils
entities.summary: The GNU core utilities collection, packaged in the MSYS environment as the primary POSIX-oriented file, shell, and text manipulation command set.

properties.role: core file, shell, and text utilities

entities.name: GNU Grep
entities.summary: The GNU string-search utility, packaged in the MSYS environment for BRE/ERE/PCRE pattern matching over text streams and files.

properties.role: pattern search over text streams and files

entities.name: GNU Sed
entities.summary: The GNU stream editor, packaged in the MSYS environment for scripted, non-interactive text transformation.

entities.name: GNU Awk (gawk)
entities.summary: GNU's implementation of the POSIX awk pattern-scanning and processing language, packaged in the MSYS environment and providing the `awk` command.

entities.name: GNU Findutils
entities.summary: The GNU file-finding utilities, packaged in the MSYS environment for predicate-based filesystem traversal and command construction over found files.

properties.role: filesystem traversal and command construction over found files

entities.name: GNU Tar
entities.summary: The GNU archiving utility, packaged in the MSYS environment for storing, backing up, and transporting file trees as a single archive stream.

entities.name: GNU Gzip
entities.summary: The GNU compression utility, packaged in the MSYS environment for single-file DEFLATE-based compression, commonly paired with tar.

entities.name: bzip2
entities.summary: A Burrows-Wheeler-based single-file compression utility, packaged in the MSYS environment and split from its shared library, libbz2.

entities.name: XZ Utils
entities.summary: The Tukaani Project's LZMA2-based compression utilities, packaged in the MSYS environment and split from their shared codec library, liblzma.

entities.name: Zstandard (zstd)
entities.summary: A fast lossless compression algorithm and CLI, packaged in the MSYS environment and split from its shared codec library, libzstd.

entities.name: Info-ZIP Zip
entities.summary: The Info-ZIP archiver that creates PKZIP-compatible .zip archives, packaged in the MSYS environment.

entities.name: Info-ZIP UnZip
entities.summary: The Info-ZIP extractor for PKZIP-compatible .zip archives, packaged in the MSYS environment.

entities.name: p7zip
entities.summary: A command-line port of the 7-Zip archiver (7z format and algorithms originating with Igor Pavlov's 7-Zip), packaged in the MSYS environment.

entities.name: Lzip
entities.summary: A single-file LZMA-based compressor designed around a simple, well-specified format optimized for long-term data safety, packaged in the MSYS environment.

entities.name: GNU Cpio
entities.summary: The GNU implementation of cpio, copying file archives to and from a cpio- or tar-format stream, packaged in the MSYS environment.

entities.name: LZ4
entities.summary: A very fast lossless compression algorithm and CLI prioritizing speed over ratio, packaged in the MSYS environment.

entities.name: liblz4
entities.summary: The LZ4 compression codec library, a distinct MSYS package from the lz4 CLI, linked by bsdcpio, bsdtar, MSYS libarchive, rsync, squashfs-tools, and subversion for LZ4-format compression support.

entities.name: libarchive (MSYS)
entities.summary: The MSYS-environment build of the multi-format archive and compression library, a distinct catalog package from the UCRT64 libarchive already documented in this knowledge base, with the widest real dependency footprint of any single MSYS library modeled to date (libbz2, libexpat, libiconv, liblz4, liblzma, libopenssl, libzstd, and zlib).

entities.name: xxHash (MSYS)
entities.summary: The MSYS-environment build of the xxHash fast non-cryptographic hash algorithm library, a distinct catalog package from the UCRT64 xxHash already documented in this knowledge base (GDB's dependency) and from the MSYS xxhash CLI package.

entities.name: libsqlite (MSYS)
entities.summary: The MSYS-environment SQLite3 library, a distinct catalog package from the UCRT64 SQLite already documented in this knowledge base, cited by name but not previously modeled as a dependency of both GnuPG and Heimdal runtime libraries.

entities.name: libsasl (MSYS)
entities.summary: The Cyrus Simple Authentication and Security Layer (SASL) library, packaged in the MSYS environment and linking against four other libraries already documented in this knowledge base (libxcrypt, libopenssl, Heimdal runtime libraries, libsqlite), consumed by mutt, neomutt, and Subversion for pluggable authentication mechanisms.

entities.name: popt (MSYS)
entities.summary: A command-line option parser library originating from the RPM project, packaged in the MSYS environment and linking against two libraries already documented in this knowledge base (GNU libiconv, GNU libintl), consumed by rsync for command-line argument parsing.

entities.name: LZO
entities.summary: A portable lossless data compression library prioritizing decompression speed, packaged in the MSYS environment and linked by lzop and squashfs-tools for LZO-format compression support.

entities.name: GNU Ed
entities.summary: The GNU implementation of ed, the POSIX-mandated line-oriented text editor, packaged in the MSYS environment.

entities.name: GNU Emacs
entities.summary: The extensible, self-documenting display editor, packaged in the MSYS environment as its console (non-GUI-toolkit) build.

entities.name: less
entities.summary: A terminal-based pager for viewing text files a screen at a time, packaged in the MSYS environment.

entities.name: mintty
entities.summary: A terminal emulator with native Windows look and feel, hosting MSYS shell sessions in the MSYS environment.

entities.name: GNU Nano
entities.summary: A small, easy-to-use screen editor descended from Pico, packaged in the MSYS environment.

entities.name: ncurses
entities.summary: The terminal-capability and screen-handling library underlying most of this batch's interactive text-mode programs, packaged in the MSYS environment.

entities.name: Vim
entities.summary: A highly configurable, improved version of the vi text editor, packaged in the MSYS environment.

entities.name: OpenSSH
entities.summary: The free implementation of the SSH protocol suite, packaged in the MSYS environment for secure remote login and file transfer.

properties.role: secure remote login and file transfer

entities.name: curl
entities.summary: A multi-protocol command-line file-transfer client, packaged in the MSYS environment and split from its transfer library, libcurl.

entities.name: Git (MSYS2 package)
entities.summary: The fast distributed version control system, packaged as a plain MSYS2 package — distinct from the separately distributed Git for Windows product documented in Volume 9.
entities.authority: Linus Torvalds / Git community (Junio C Hamano, maintainer)

entities.name: GnuPG
entities.summary: A complete implementation of the OpenPGP standard for encryption and signing, packaged in the MSYS environment.

entities.name: OpenSSL
entities.summary: A general-purpose cryptography and TLS/SSL toolkit, packaged in the MSYS environment and split from its shared cryptographic library, libopenssl.

entities.name: GCC
entities.summary: The GNU Compiler Collection, packaged per native environment (UCRT64 shown here) as the default C/C++/OpenMP compiler driver for MinGW-w64 targets.

entities.name: GNU Binutils
entities.summary: The GNU binary utilities (assembler, linker, and object-file tools), packaged per native environment (UCRT64 shown here) as GCC's default backend toolchain.

entities.name: GDB
entities.summary: The GNU Debugger, packaged per native environment (UCRT64 shown here) as the default debugger for GCC-oriented environments.

entities.name: Clang
entities.summary: The C language family frontend for LLVM, packaged per native environment (CLANG64 shown here) as the default compiler driver for LLVM-oriented MinGW-w64 targets.

entities.name: LLD
entities.summary: The LLVM linker, packaged per native environment (CLANG64 shown here) as Clang's default backend linker.

entities.name: LLDB
entities.summary: The LLVM debugger, packaged per native environment (CLANG64 shown here) as the default debugger for LLVM-oriented environments.

entities.name: CMake
entities.summary: A cross-platform build-system generator, packaged per native environment (UCRT64 shown here), producing native build files (including Ninja) rather than building directly.

entities.name: Meson
entities.summary: A high-productivity build system, packaged per native environment (UCRT64 shown here), generating Ninja build files by default rather than building directly.

entities.name: Ninja
entities.summary: A small, fast build-file executor, packaged per native environment (UCRT64 shown here) and used as the default backend for both CMake and Meson.

entities.name: pkgconf
entities.summary: A pkg-config-compatible library-metadata query tool, packaged per native environment (UCRT64 shown here) as the packaged substitute for the original freedesktop.org pkg-config.

entities.name: GNU Autoconf
entities.summary: An m4-macro-based framework for generating portable configure scripts, packaged in the MSYS environment.

entities.name: GNU Automake
entities.summary: A tool for generating portable Makefile.in files from higher-level Makefile.am descriptions, packaged in the MSYS environment as multiple side-by-side versioned packages dispatched by a wrapper script.

entities.name: GNU Libtool
entities.summary: A generic library-build support script generator, providing a portable interface for building shared and static libraries, packaged in the MSYS environment.

entities.name: GNU Make
entities.summary: A dependency-rule build-file executor, packaged both in the MSYS environment and, separately, as a native build for each MinGW-w64 environment.

entities.name: libstdc++
entities.summary: GCC's C++ standard library implementation, bundled inside the gcc-libs package rather than distributed as a standalone MSYS2 package.

entities.name: libc++
entities.summary: LLVM's C++ standard library implementation, packaged standalone for CLANG64, UCRT64, and MINGW64 rather than bundled with a compiler package.

entities.name: zlib
entities.summary: A general-purpose DEFLATE compression library, packaged per native environment (UCRT64 shown here) and, per this snapshot, the single most-depended-upon library in this knowledge base.

entities.name: GNU libiconv
entities.summary: A character-set conversion library, packaged per native environment (UCRT64 shown here) and depended on across most of this environment's text-processing tools.

entities.name: GNU gettext
entities.summary: The GNU internationalization (NLS) runtime library, packaged per native environment (UCRT64 shown here) as gettext-runtime, separate from the gettext-tools and gettext-libtextstyle packages.

entities.name: Expat
entities.summary: A stream-oriented XML parser library, packaged per native environment (UCRT64 shown here) and used by several other tools documented in this knowledge base (CMake, GDB) for XML-format handling.

entities.name: libxml2
entities.summary: A full-featured XML parsing and toolkit library, packaged per native environment (UCRT64 shown here) with built-in character-set conversion and compressed-XML support.

entities.name: ICU (International Components for Unicode)
entities.summary: A mature Unicode and internationalization library covering text handling, collation, formatting, and locale data, packaged per native environment (UCRT64 shown here).

entities.name: Boost
entities.summary: A large collection of peer-reviewed, portable C++ source libraries, packaged per native environment (UCRT64 shown here) with optional Python-binding support.

entities.name: SQLite
entities.summary: A self-contained, serverless SQL database engine library, packaged per native environment (UCRT64 shown here) and depended on by GnuPG for its key/trust database, among others.

entities.name: GNU Readline
entities.summary: A library providing line editing, history, and completion for interactive command-line programs, packaged per native environment (UCRT64 shown here) and depended on by GDB and GnuPG.

properties.role: interactive line editing, history, and completion

entities.name: GNU MP (GMP)
entities.summary: An arbitrary-precision arithmetic library, packaged per native environment (UCRT64 shown here) and depended on by GCC, GDB, and the MPFR/MPC/ISL libraries that in turn depend on it.

entities.name: GNU MPFR
entities.summary: A multiple-precision, correctly-rounded floating-point library built on GMP, packaged per native environment (UCRT64 shown here) and depended on by GCC and GDB for arbitrary-precision evaluation.

entities.name: GNU MPC
entities.summary: A multiple-precision complex-number arithmetic library built on GMP and MPFR, packaged per native environment (UCRT64 shown here) and depended on by GCC.
entities.authority: The MPC team (Andreas Enge et al.)

entities.name: isl (Integer Set Library)
entities.summary: A library for manipulating sets and relations of integer points bounded by linear constraints, built on GMP and packaged per native environment (UCRT64 shown here); backs GCC's Graphite loop-optimization framework.
entities.authority: The isl team (Sven Verdoolaege et al.)

entities.name: libwinpthread
entities.summary: The MinGW-w64 project's POSIX-threads-style threading runtime for Windows, packaged per native environment (UCRT64 shown here) and, per this snapshot, the third most-depended-upon package identified in this knowledge base.

entities.name: winpthreads
entities.summary: A version-pinned companion package to libwinpthread, packaged per native environment (UCRT64 shown here); its exact relationship to libwinpthread is unresolved, complicated by a separate winpthreads-stub package that provides/conflicts with it as a near-empty placeholder alternative.

entities.name: PCRE2
entities.summary: A library implementing Perl 5-style regular expressions, packaged per native environment (UCRT64 shown here) and backing the -P/--perl-regexp matching engines already documented for grep and less.

entities.name: libgpg-error
entities.summary: A shared error-code definition library used across the GnuPG project's own library stack, packaged per native environment (UCRT64 shown here) and the common foundation beneath libgcrypt, libassuan, and libksba.

properties.role: shared error-code definitions for the GnuPG library stack

entities.name: libgcrypt
entities.summary: GnuPG's general-purpose cryptographic library, packaged per native environment (UCRT64 shown here) and the primary low-level crypto library backing GnuPG itself.

entities.name: libassuan
entities.summary: An IPC library used by GnuPG-related software to communicate between cooperating processes (gpg, dirmngr, pinentry), packaged per native environment (UCRT64 shown here).

properties.role: inter-process communication for GnuPG's split-process architecture

entities.name: libksba
entities.summary: A CMS and X.509 certificate access library, packaged per native environment (UCRT64 shown here) and used specifically by GnuPG's S/MIME support despite GnuPG's primary focus being OpenPGP.

entities.name: nPth (New Portable Threads)
entities.summary: GnuPG's own portable threading library, packaged per native environment (UCRT64 shown here) and used internally for GnuPG's concurrent operations.

properties.role: portable threading for GnuPG's internal concurrency

entities.name: Nettle
entities.summary: A low-level cryptographic library, packaged per native environment (UCRT64 shown here) and used by GnuTLS and GnuPG for additional cryptographic primitives.

entities.name: GnuTLS
entities.summary: A library implementing TLS/SSL and related cryptographic protocols, packaged in the MSYS environment and depended on by GnuPG's dirmngr network lookups and GNU Emacs' Network Security Manager.

entities.name: GNU libidn2
entities.summary: An implementation of the IDNA2008, Punycode, and TR46 internationalized domain name specifications, packaged in the MSYS environment and depended on by both GnuTLS and libcurl.

entities.name: GNU Libtasn1
entities.summary: A library for Abstract Syntax Notation One (ASN.1) and Distinguished Encoding Rules (DER) manipulation, packaged in the MSYS environment and depended on by both GnuTLS and libp11-kit for certificate structure parsing.

entities.name: p11-kit
entities.summary: A library that provides a way to load and enumerate PKCS#11 modules, plus a standard configuration for sharing them between applications, packaged in the MSYS environment and depended on by GnuTLS for hardware-token/smart-card support.

entities.name: libpsl
entities.summary: A library for parsing and evaluating a domain name against Mozilla's Public Suffix List, packaged in the MSYS environment and depended on by both curl and libcurl for cookie-domain-scoping safety.

properties.role: Public Suffix List parsing and evaluation

entities.name: GNU libunistring
entities.summary: A library for manipulating Unicode strings and C strings, packaged in the MSYS environment and depended on by curl, libcurl, libidn2, and libpsl for Unicode-aware string processing.

entities.name: libnghttp2
entities.summary: A reusable C library implementing the framing layer of HTTP/2, packaged in the MSYS environment and depended on by both curl and libcurl for HTTP/2 protocol support.

entities.name: libnghttp3
entities.summary: An HTTP/3 protocol library, packaged in the MSYS environment and depended on by both curl and libcurl for HTTP/3 protocol support, alongside libngtcp2's QUIC transport.

entities.name: libngtcp2
entities.summary: An implementation of the IETF QUIC transport protocol, packaged in the MSYS environment and depended on by both curl and libcurl to carry HTTP/3 traffic (via libnghttp3) over QUIC.

entities.name: libedit
entities.summary: An autotool- and libtoolized port of the NetBSD Editline library, providing readline-style interactive line editing, packaged in the MSYS environment and depended on by OpenSSH for sftp's command prompt.

entities.name: libxcrypt
entities.summary: A modern library for one-way hashing of passwords (the crypt() family), packaged in the MSYS environment and depended on by OpenSSH for local password-based authentication checks.

entities.name: libfido2
entities.summary: A library implementing the FIDO2/U2F protocols, including communication with hardware security keys over USB, packaged in the MSYS environment and depended on by OpenSSH for FIDO2-based public-key authentication.

entities.name: Heimdal
entities.summary: An implementation of the Kerberos V5 protocol and libraries, packaged in the MSYS environment and depended on by OpenSSH for optional GSSAPI-based (Kerberos single sign-on) authentication.

entities.name: cppdap
entities.summary: A C++ library implementing the Debug Adapter Protocol (DAP), packaged per native environment (UCRT64 shown here) and depended on by CMake to back its --debugger DAP server for debugging CMakeLists.txt script execution.

entities.name: JsonCpp
entities.summary: A C++ library for reading and writing JSON, packaged per native environment (UCRT64 shown here) and depended on by CMake to back its JSON-based file-api and CMakePresets.json/CMakeUserPresets.json support.

entities.name: libarchive
entities.summary: A multi-format archive and compression library, packaged per native environment (UCRT64 shown here) and depended on by CMake to back file(ARCHIVE_CREATE)/file(ARCHIVE_EXTRACT) and CPack's archive-format generator.

entities.name: libuv
entities.summary: A cross-platform asynchronous I/O library, packaged per native environment (UCRT64 shown here) and depended on by CMake for internal asynchronous I/O, historically introduced for CMake's server mode.

entities.name: RHash
entities.summary: A library and utility for computing hash sums across many algorithms, packaged per native environment (UCRT64 shown here) and depended on by CMake to back its file(MD5)/file(SHA256)-style hashing commands.

entities.name: file
entities.summary: A file-type identification utility and library, packaged in the MSYS environment and depended on by GNU Nano to help select a syntax-highlighting rule set for files without a recognized extension.

entities.name: GNU termcap
entities.summary: A terminal feature (capability) database library, packaged per native environment (UCRT64 shown here) and depended on by GNU Readline to determine cursor-movement and editing escape sequences for the active terminal.

entities.name: WinEditLine
entities.summary: An EditLine API implementation for the native Windows Console, packaged per native environment (UCRT64 shown here) and depended on by PCRE2 to back interactive line editing in its bundled pcre2test tool.

properties.role: interactive line editing for native Windows console programs

entities.name: libgcrypt (MSYS)
entities.summary: GnuPG's own general-purpose cryptographic library, packaged in the MSYS environment specifically — the package GnuPG's own MSYS build actually depends on, distinct from the separately versioned UCRT64 libgcrypt this knowledge base's library:gnupg:libgcrypt entity documents.

entities.name: libassuan (MSYS)
entities.summary: The Assuan IPC protocol library GnuPG uses for communication between gpg, dirmngr, and other GnuPG-family helper processes, packaged in the MSYS environment specifically — the package GnuPG's own MSYS build actually depends on, distinct from the separately versioned UCRT64 libassuan this knowledge base's library:gnupg:libassuan entity documents.

properties.role: Assuan IPC protocol for GnuPG component communication

entities.name: libksba (MSYS)
entities.summary: GnuPG's X.509/CMS certificate-parsing library, used by GnuPG's S/MIME support (gpgsm), packaged in the MSYS environment specifically — the package GnuPG's own MSYS build actually depends on, distinct from the separately versioned UCRT64 libksba this knowledge base's library:gnupg:libksba entity documents.

entities.name: nPth (MSYS)
entities.summary: GnuPG's own portable threading library (New/Nth Pth), used internally for concurrent operations, packaged in the MSYS environment specifically — the package GnuPG's own MSYS build actually depends on, distinct from the separately versioned UCRT64 npth this knowledge base's library:gnupg:npth entity documents.

entities.name: Nettle (MSYS)
entities.summary: A low-level cryptographic library backing GnuPG's additional cryptographic primitives, packaged in the MSYS environment specifically — the package GnuPG's own MSYS build actually depends on, distinct from the separately versioned UCRT64 Nettle this knowledge base's library:nettle:nettle entity documents.

entities.name: libgpg-error (MSYS)
entities.summary: GnuPG's shared error-code vocabulary library, consumed by libgcrypt, libassuan, and libksba, packaged in the MSYS environment specifically — the package GnuPG's own MSYS-packaged crypto stack actually depends on, distinct from the separately versioned UCRT64 libgpg-error this knowledge base's library:gnupg:libgpg-error entity documents.

properties.role: shared error-code vocabulary for the GnuPG library stack

entities.name: GNU libintl
entities.summary: The GNU Internationalization (gettext) runtime library, packaged in the MSYS environment and depended on by the majority of MSYS-environment components documented in this knowledge base for translated (NLS) message output.

entities.name: libcurl
entities.summary: The multi-protocol file-transfer library underlying the curl CLI, packaged in the MSYS environment and also depended on directly by GnuPG's dirmngr for HTTP-based key-server and certificate-revocation lookups.

entities.name: PCRE2 (MSYS)
entities.summary: A library implementing Perl-compatible regular expressions, packaged in the MSYS environment specifically as libpcre2_8 — depended on by Git (git grep --perl-regexp) and less, distinct from the separately versioned UCRT64 PCRE2 this knowledge base's library:pcre:pcre2 entity documents.

entities.name: PCRE (MSYS)
entities.summary: The original (PCRE1) library implementing Perl-compatible regular expressions, packaged in the MSYS environment as libpcre — depended on by GNU Grep's -P/--perl-regexp matching engine, and superseded upstream by PCRE2 (documented separately in this volume).

entities.name: GNU Readline (MSYS)
entities.summary: A library providing line editing, history, and completion for interactive command-line programs, packaged in the MSYS environment specifically as libreadline — depended on by GnuPG's interactive prompts and gawk's built-in debugger, distinct from the separately versioned UCRT64 GNU Readline this knowledge base's library:gnu:readline entity documents.

properties.role: interactive line editing, history, and completion

entities.name: GNU Libltdl
entities.summary: A system-independent dlopen() wrapper library for GNU Libtool, packaged in the MSYS environment and depended on by GNU Libtool itself.

properties.role: portable dlopen() wrapper for GNU Libtool

entities.name: Zstandard (library)
entities.summary: The Zstandard compression library, packaged per native environment (UCRT64 shown here) and depended on by GCC and Binutils to back compressed debug-section support, with 94 recorded reverse dependents in this environment — the widest of any library added in this batch.

entities.name: LLVM libraries
entities.summary: LLVM's shared object-file and code-generation infrastructure libraries, packaged per native environment (CLANG64 shown here) and depended on by LLD and LLDB, both built on this shared infrastructure.

entities.name: Clang libraries
entities.summary: Clang's own shared libraries (parsing, semantic analysis, code generation), packaged per native environment (CLANG64 shown here), separated from the CLI driver package and reused by LLDB for expression evaluation during debugging sessions.

properties.role: Clang parsing, semantic analysis, and code generation

entities.name: xxHash
entities.summary: An extremely fast non-cryptographic hash algorithm library, packaged per native environment (UCRT64 shown here) and depended on by GDB to back its debug-info index/cache features for fast repeated symbol lookups.

entities.name: liblzma (XZ Utils library)
entities.summary: The compression library underlying XZ Utils, packaged per native environment (UCRT64 shown here) and depended on by GDB to back reading debug information compressed with the xz/LZMA algorithm.

entities.name: GNU libiconv (MSYS)
entities.summary: A character-set conversion library, packaged in the MSYS environment specifically — the MSYS C library (Cygwin-derived) has no built-in iconv conversion the way glibc does, so GnuTLS, GnuPG, Coreutils, and several MSYS-packaged libraries this knowledge base already documents all link the standalone GNU libiconv instead, distinct from the separately versioned UCRT64 libiconv this knowledge base's library:gnu:libiconv entity documents.

entities.name: GNU MP (MSYS)
entities.summary: The GNU Multiple Precision arithmetic library, packaged in the MSYS environment specifically — depended on by GnuTLS and GNU Coreutils' factor utility, distinct from the separately versioned UCRT64 GMP this knowledge base's library:gnu:gmp entity documents.

entities.name: Expat (MSYS)
entities.summary: A stream-oriented XML parser library, packaged in the MSYS environment specifically — depended on by Git for git-svn and remote-helper XML handling, distinct from the separately versioned UCRT64 Expat this knowledge base's library:libexpat:expat entity documents.

entities.name: libxml2 (MSYS)
entities.summary: The GNOME project's XML parsing library, packaged in the MSYS environment specifically — depended on by GNU Emacs for its built-in libxml2-based parsing (used by features such as the eww web browser), distinct from the separately versioned UCRT64 libxml2 this knowledge base's library:gnome:libxml2 entity documents.

entities.name: zlib (CLANG64)
entities.summary: The zlib compression library, packaged in the CLANG64 environment specifically and depended on by LLD and LLDB, distinct from the separately versioned UCRT64 zlib this knowledge base's library:gnu:zlib entity documents.

entities.name: Zstandard (CLANG64)
entities.summary: The Zstandard compression library, packaged in the CLANG64 environment specifically and depended on by LLD to back compressed debug-section support, distinct from the separately versioned UCRT64 Zstandard this knowledge base's library:facebook:zstd entity documents.

entities.name: libcbor
entities.summary: A C library for parsing and generating CBOR, a general-purpose schema-less binary data format, packaged in the MSYS environment and depended on by libfido2 for its own CBOR-encoded FIDO2/U2F protocol data.

entities.name: Heimdal runtime libraries
entities.summary: The runtime shared-library half of the Heimdal Kerberos V5 package, packaged in the MSYS environment and depended on by the Heimdal CLI/tools package itself, following the same CLI/library-package split pattern already documented for curl/libcurl and OpenSSL/libopenssl.

entities.name: zlib (MSYS)
entities.summary: The zlib compression library, packaged in the MSYS environment specifically — with 60 recorded reverse dependents, depended on directly by curl, GNU Emacs, GnuPG, libcurl, libfido2, and file, all already documented in this knowledge base, distinct from the separately versioned UCRT64 zlib this knowledge base's library:gnu:zlib entity documents.

entities.name: Brotli
entities.summary: The Brotli compression library, packaged in the MSYS environment and depended on by libcurl for HTTP Content-Encoding: br compressed response support.

entities.name: ca-certificates
entities.summary: A curated bundle of common Certificate Authority root certificates, packaged in the MSYS environment and depended on by curl and libcurl to back TLS certificate-chain verification against a trusted root store.

entities.name: libssh2
entities.summary: A client-side C library implementing the SSH2 protocol, packaged in the MSYS environment and depended on by libcurl to back the sftp:// and scp:// URL schemes.

entities.name: Zstandard (MSYS library)
entities.summary: The Zstandard compression library runtime package, packaged in the MSYS environment specifically and depended on by libcurl and file, distinct from both the MSYS zstd CLI tool package and this knowledge base's UCRT64/CLANG64 Zstandard library entities.

entities.name: libbz2
entities.summary: The Burrows-Wheeler compression codec library split from the MSYS bzip2 CLI package, linked by bzip2, file, gnupg, zip, and unzip for bzip2-format decompression support.

entities.name: GNU MPFR (MSYS)
entities.summary: The GNU multiple-precision floating-point library, packaged in the MSYS environment specifically — depended on by gawk's --bignum arbitrary-precision mode, distinct from the separately versioned UCRT64 MPFR this knowledge base's library:gnu:mpfr entity documents.

entities.name: libnettle
entities.summary: The base Nettle cryptographic library, packaged in the MSYS environment as a separate catalog entity from the package:msys2:nettle meta-package — depended on by GnuTLS directly and by nettle (MSYS) transitively.

entities.name: libhogweed

claims.subject: environment:msys2:msys
claims.statement: MSYS is the POSIX-oriented system and package-management environment.

claims.subject: environment:msys2:ucrt64
claims.statement: UCRT64 is the recommended default native MSYS2 environment.

claims.subject: environment:msys2:clang64
claims.statement: CLANG64 uses the UCRT with the LLVM/Clang compiler family and libc++.

claims.subject: environment:msys2:clangarm64
claims.statement: CLANGARM64 uses the UCRT with the LLVM/Clang compiler family and libc++ on AArch64.

claims.subject: environment:msys2:mingw64
claims.statement: MINGW64 is deprecated as of 2026-03-15.

claims.subject: environment:msys2:mingw32
claims.statement: MINGW32 is in phase-out lifecycle status.

claims.subject: component:gnu:bash
claims.statement: The MSYS bash package provides the `sh` command.

claims.subject: component:gnu:coreutils
claims.statement: GNU Coreutils packages the core POSIX-oriented file, shell, and text manipulation utilities for the MSYS environment.

claims.subject: component:gnu:gawk
claims.statement: The MSYS gawk package provides the `awk` command.

claims.subject: component:gnu:findutils
claims.statement: GNU Findutils packages the file-locating and command-construction utilities (including `find` and `xargs`) for the MSYS environment.

claims.subject: component:gnu:gzip
claims.statement: The MSYS gzip package's dependencies on bash and less reflect its bundled shell-script wrappers (zcat, zless, zgrep, zcmp, zdiff) rather than a dependency of the core gzip/gunzip binary itself.

claims.subject: component:bzip2:bzip2
claims.statement: The MSYS bzip2 CLI package is split from and links against libbz2, its shared compression library, rather than bundling the codec statically.

claims.subject: component:info-zip:zip
claims.statement: Zip and UnZip support the bzip2 compression method within .zip archives, explaining their libbz2 dependency.

claims.subject: component:lz4:lz4
claims.statement: The MSYS lz4 package's declared dependency on lz4 itself reflects a version-pinned constraint against its own bundled shared library rather than a distinct dependency package.

claims.subject: component:greenwood:less
claims.statement: less's dependency on libpcre2_8 backs Perl-compatible regular-expression support in its search functionality.

claims.subject: component:vim:vim
claims.statement: Vim's dependency on perl reflects optional built-in Perl-interpreter integration, enabling embedded Perl scripting via :perl.

claims.subject: component:gnu:ncurses
claims.statement: ncurses is the most-depended-upon package observed in this catalog snapshot among the tools modeled in this knowledge base, reflecting its role as the shared terminal-capability library underlying nearly every interactive text-mode program.

claims.subject: component:git:git
claims.statement: Git's runtime dependency on nano reflects its use as a guaranteed-present fallback editor for commit messages and interactive commands when no EDITOR/core.editor/VISUAL is configured, not a build-time requirement of Git's own functionality.

claims.subject: component:git:git
claims.statement: The git component modeled in this volume is the plain MSYS2-packaged git, distinct from the separately distributed Git for Windows product documented in Volume 9; both distributions track upstream Git 2.55.0 as of their respective 2026-07-29 and 2026-07-30 observations, but have separate package and release provenance.

claims.subject: component:gnu:gcc
claims.statement: GCC's dependencies on gmp, mpfr, and mpc back arbitrary-precision arithmetic used during compilation (for example, constant folding), and its dependency on isl backs the Graphite loop-optimization framework.

claims.subject: component:gnu:binutils
claims.statement: Binutils' dependencies on zlib and zstd back compressed debug-section support (--compress-debug-sections=zlib|zstd).

claims.subject: component:gnu:gdb
claims.statement: GDB's dependency on python backs its Python scripting API (pretty-printers, gdb.execute), and its optional dependency on python-pygments backs syntax-highlighted source-code display.

claims.subject: component:llvm:lldb
claims.statement: LLDB's dependency on python backs its Python scripting API, the same scripting-extensibility pattern documented for GDB.

claims.subject: component:llvm:lld
claims.statement: The MSYS2 lld package declares that it provides the binutils virtual capability in the CLANG64 environment, letting packages that depend on a generic binutils-like toolchain resolve against LLD instead of GNU Binutils.

claims.subject: component:cmake:cmake
claims.statement: CMake's dependencies map to specific built-in features: cppdap backs its --debugger Debug Adapter Protocol support, curl backs file(DOWNLOAD)/ExternalProject network operations, jsoncpp backs its JSON-based file-api and CMakePresets.json support, libarchive backs file(ARCHIVE_CREATE) and CPack archive generation, and rhash backs its file(<HASH>) commands.

claims.subject: component:mesonbuild:meson
claims.statement: Meson's dependency on ninja reflects Ninja as its default and primary build backend: Meson generates build files that Ninja executes rather than compiling directly.

claims.subject: component:pkgconf:pkgconf
claims.statement: The MSYS2 pkgconf package provides, conflicts with, and replaces pkg-config in this environment, making pkgconf the packaged substitute for the original freedesktop.org pkg-config tool.

claims.subject: component:gnu:autoconf
claims.statement: Autoconf is fundamentally an m4 macro-processing framework: autoconf/autoheader/autoreconf expand m4 macros to generate a portable configure script, which explains its dependency on m4.

claims.subject: component:gnu:automake
claims.statement: MSYS2 packages automake as multiple side-by-side versioned packages (automake1.11 through automake1.18 in this snapshot), with automake-wrapper acting as a version-dispatching frontend that provides the generic automake/aclocal commands.

claims.subject: component:gnu:libtool
claims.statement: Libtool's primary artifact, the project-local libtool script, is itself a generated shell script executed via bash, which explains the package's dependency on bash.

claims.subject: library:gnu:libstdc++
claims.statement: libstdc++ is not packaged as a standalone MSYS2 package; it is bundled inside gcc-libs alongside libgcc, libgomp, and other GCC runtime support libraries.

claims.subject: library:llvm:libc++
claims.statement: In CLANG64, the libc++ package itself provides the gcc-libs/cc-libs virtual capability, since no separate GCC runtime package exists in that environment; in UCRT64, libc++ instead depends on the cc-libs capability that gcc-libs provides there.

claims.subject: library:llvm:libc++
claims.statement: libc++ is packaged for UCRT64 and MINGW64 as well as CLANG64, meaning a project can opt into libc++ even in a GCC-oriented environment rather than being restricted to libstdc++.

claims.subject: library:gnu:zlib
claims.statement: zlib is the most-depended-upon package observed in this catalog snapshot among all components and libraries modeled in this knowledge base, with 299 recorded reverse dependents, exceeding gcc-libs' 167.

claims.subject: library:gnu:gettext
claims.statement: GNU gettext is split into three separate MSYS2 packages: gettext-runtime (the libintl runtime library), gettext-tools (msgfmt/xgettext/msginit and other CLI tools), and gettext-libtextstyle (a terminal text-styling library used by the tools); this page models the runtime component.

claims.subject: library:gnome:libxml2
claims.statement: libxml2's dependencies on libiconv and zlib back its character-encoding conversion and compressed-XML (gzip) reading support respectively.

claims.subject: library:sqlite:sqlite3
claims.statement: SQLite's dependency on tcl reflects its own canonical test-suite tooling, which is Tcl-based, bundled into this package rather than a runtime requirement of the SQL engine itself.

claims.subject: library:pcre:pcre2
claims.statement: pcre2's dependency on wineditline backs interactive line editing in its bundled pcre2test tool, the Windows port of the BSD editline library serving a comparable role to GNU Readline elsewhere in this volume.

claims.subject: library:mingw-w64:winpthreads
claims.statement: The MSYS2 winpthreads package's exact relationship to libwinpthread is unresolved from package-level evidence alone: the version-pinned dependency and near-identical summaries are consistent with a development/runtime split, but a separate winpthreads-stub package that provides/conflicts with winpthreads (a near-empty, 8-byte-installed placeholder swappable for it) argues against a simple dev-headers theory and toward winpthreads containing a real, optionally-replaceable implementation component instead. Neither theory is confirmed against file contents.
